div.style: width: 880px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 4px 56px 12px 56px; background: transparent; color: #ECE7DF; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif
display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(8, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px
